Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Enum Class ColumnType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<ColumnType>
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.ColumnType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<ColumnType>, Constable
public enum ColumnType extends Enum<ColumnType>
The column types a Blueprint can declare.

More constants are added in later versions. A grammar that does not handle a type refuses it with an error naming the type, instead of writing wrong SQL.
